errors.text_span: The approximate perplexity values of the bars increase with higher sparsity rates
errors.evidence: The description states 'increase with higher sparsity rates,' but the actual values show an increasing pattern from 10% to 70%, with a significant jump at 80% sparsity.
The description fails to mention the logarithmic scale of the vertical axis for perplexity.
The purpose of the chart is not clearly stated; the comparison of perplexity values is only mentioned without the context of the experiment.
